task: T3: create the file scripts/loops/build-container.env. Write it from this description alone — everything required is here, and no other file needs to be consulted. It contains exactly three settings plus a short comment header explaining that this strategy is the build loop driven through the containerised executor binding. The three settings are: STRATEGY_DESC set to a one-line description string (run-loop.sh --list prints it); STRATEGY_PHASES set to the single word build in double quotes, meaning one build phase and nothing after it; and the line `export RALPH_EXEC_CMD="${RALPH_EXEC_CMD:-${SCRIPT_DIR:-scripts}/exec-container.sh}"` copied with that exact parameter-expansion shape, so an operator override still wins. Set nothing else. In particular do not set RALPH_AGENT: this binding runs the same executor as a normal build, reached through a container, and the acceptance for this spec is that the evidence record differs only in its `binding` field — setting RALPH_AGENT would make the `agent` field differ too and destroy that comparison. Create only this one file.
